bibl.title: The Greeks at Kom Wasit (Western Nile Delta), Egypt.
bibl.seg: Mohamed Kenawi & Cristina Mondin, The Greeks at Kom Wasit (Western Nile Delta), Egypt.

Grażyna Bąkowska-Czerner & Rafał Czerner (edd.), Greco-Roman Cities at the Crossroads of Cultures. The 20th Anniversary of Polish-Egyptian Conservation Mission Marina el-Alamein (Oxford, 2019) pp. 137-143, figg.
bibl.note: Presents new finds from the Western Nile Delta related to the early presence of the Greeks in Egypt. Archaeologists have discovered various material culture similar to the one found at Sais and Naukratis for the first time at Kom Wasit in 2016. These finds, which are the result of a recent archaeological excavation, allow us to give a better interpretation of the region, and provide new evidence of dating.
